I can't seem to shake out the habit of doom-scrolling. I know it's pointless and bad for me. But I just keep doing it regardless.
</message>
output: I think I do it because it's easier than sitting with whatever's actually bothering me. There's some comfort in the numbness, even if I hate myself a little for it afterward. I guess I'm scared that if I stop, I'll just be alone with my own thoughts and I'm not sure I want that either.
